## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Restore the empty-criteria check in `requirement_proven` before merge. The pull request says "No behavior change is intended", but with this change a requirement that has no criteria counts as proven.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` across 180 handler modules. It also switches `by_name` to `operator.itemgetter`, rewrites `requirement_proven` to compare a sum of proven flags against the criteria count, and adds a top-level `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Restore the empty-criteria guard in requirement_proven — For `criteria=[]`, `sum(...)` is 0 and `len(criteria)` is 0, so `proven == len(criteria)` returns `True`; the old `bool(criteria) and all(...)` returned `False`. The `log.warning` on line 10 still fires, and then execution continues into the success result. `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py:17` never calls this function with an empty list. — A release-review requirement with no criteria now counts as proven, so an unverified requirement passes the gate. — Fix: Return `bool(criteria) and all(item["proven"] for item in criteria)` and add an empty-list assertion to `test_requirement_proof`.

- 178 of the 180 `app/handlers/h*_records.py` files (all except `h000_records.py` and `h001_records.py`) were not read in full; this review checked their changed lines by pattern-matching them against the mechanical typing and `log.warning` replacement, and every changed line matched.
